exposure: BCS diagnosis timing (pre-conception, during/after pregnancy, after family completion)
Women with BCS diagnosed during pregnancy
cohort: 121 female patients with BCS attending a liver clinic from 2017 to 2020
finding: Infertility is common in patients with BCS, but pregnancy is well-tolerated in those with compensated liver disease, and endovascular intervention may improve fertility outcomes.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery was vaginal in 88% of cases.
